lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular maculae of varying diameters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal maculae rows to form a quasi-rectilinear grid pattern on the posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear ridge visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity illumination on the superior edge and a shadow-cast inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of low-diameter high-intensity spots in the cephalic region anterior to the gill slits, transitioning to significantly larger and more widely spaced maculae along the posterior longitudinal axis.
